About.title: A renovation atelier focused on the whole.
About.intro: FORMA. began from a simple conviction: a good apartment renovation is more than a list of works — it is a composition of light, materials and everyday movement.
About.p1: We design and deliver renovations of city apartments in Prague and the Central Bohemian Region. Architectural sensitivity meets precise construction coordination so the result feels natural — and lasts.
About.p2: Every project is led personally. From the first survey to handover you have one studio, one team and a clear plan.
About.caption: We work with authentic materials and a calm palette that respects both the building and the lives of its residents.
About.imageAlt: Modern living space with timber surfaces and soft daylight
About.statsNote: Figures illustrate the website presentation — they are not verified references for a real studio.

Services.title: Renovation led from the first sketch to the final detail.
Services.description: Four areas in which we hold the whole process — design, material, craft and schedule.

kompletni.title: Complete renovation
kompletni.description: From the first survey to turnkey handover. We coordinate trades, timing and details so the build stays calm.

koupelny.title: Kitchens and bathrooms
koupelny.description: Spatially intelligent solutions with an emphasis on material, light and everyday comfort. Designed and built.

dispozice.title: Layout changes
dispozice.description: Open plans, new sightlines and a better flow of daylight. We work with the apartment’s architecture, not against it.

design.title: Design and materials
design.description: Surfaces, colour and atelier-level details that hold the whole together — from floors to handles.

HomePortfolio.title: Spaces that already live their own life.
HomePortfolio.description: Three demonstration projects — different sizes, the same care for detail and atmosphere.

Process.title: Four steps from the first meeting to handover.
Process.description: A clear sequence without unnecessary administration. You always know what is happening and why.

01.title: Consultation
01.description: We discuss your ideas, the apartment layout and a realistic budget. Together we set the project direction.

02.title: Design
02.description: We prepare the layout, materials and a precise works plan. Everything is approved before construction begins.

03.title: Construction
03.description: Craft teams work to schedule. You have one point of contact and ongoing progress photos.

04.title: Handover
04.description: We finish the details, carry out checks and hand over an apartment ready to live in — including documentation.

Contact.title: Let’s shape a space that fits you.
Contact.description: A no-obligation consultation at your home or in our studio. We will discuss layout, budget and possible start dates.

Footer.tagline: A studio for complete apartment renovations. Prague and surroundings — design, delivery and oversight of every detail.

byt-vinohrady.title: Vinohrady Apartment
byt-vinohrady.summary: A careful renewal of a period apartment with an open living space and a calm material palette.
byt-vinohrady.description: A demonstration of a full apartment renovation in a Vinohrady tenement building. The aim was to keep the character of the original ceilings and windows while creating a contemporary, airy interior for everyday life. The layout opens towards daylight, services are consolidated, and the materials stay restrained — oak, stone and soft plaster.
byt-vinohrady.heroAlt: Bright living room in a Vinohrady apartment after renovation
gallery: Open living space with dining table
Bedroom with textile curtains and soft light
Detail of storage and table lighting
byt-vinohrady.beforeAfterCaption: An illustrative comparison of materials and light — demonstration photography, not documentation of a specific build.
challenges: Preserve original ceiling height with a new floor build-up and concealed services.
Open the layout without losing acoustic privacy for the bedroom.
Balance historic building details with contemporary technical standards.
solutions: Low floor assemblies and carefully routed installations in existing cores.
A sliding door leaf and gentle zoning with furniture instead of heavy partitions.
Restored window reveals and unified surfaces in one calm palette.

loft-karlin.title: Karlín Loft
loft-karlin.summary: An industrial loft with a warm interior, studio light and carefully concealed technical systems.
loft-karlin.description: A generous loft in Karlín needed a clearer division of zones: work, rest and social living within one open volume. The design works with height, warm textiles and a contrast of smooth surfaces against the industrial character of the building. Services are hidden; light is composed in layers.
loft-karlin.heroAlt: Open loft living space in Karlín
gallery: Loft living zone with a high ceiling
Kitchen island in an open layout
challenges: Tame the acoustics of a large open space.
Create an intimate sleeping zone without closing the loft entirely.
solutions: Textile curtains, rugs and acoustic lining on selected walls.
A semi-open sleeping niche with gently separated light scenes.
A technical shaft and joinery designed as storage at the same time.

apartman-mala-strana.title: Malá Strana Apartment
apartman-mala-strana.summary: Compact living focused on craft, storage and the atmosphere of a historic house.
apartman-mala-strana.description: A smaller apartment in the historic centre shows that limited floor area need not mean a compromise in atmosphere. We worked with made-to-measure joinery, light surfaces and a careful rhythm of storage. Every detail has a purpose — and still feels calm.
apartman-mala-strana.heroAlt: Compact living room of a Malá Strana apartment
challenges: Gain enough storage without visual clutter.
Keep a sense of airiness in a deep plan.
Unify different floor levels in a historic building.
solutions: Full-height wardrobes matched to the wall colour with concealed handles.
Light surfaces, mirrored planes and continuous flooring.
Levelled floors and a consistent skirting line throughout.

byt-zizkov.title: Žižkov Apartment
byt-zizkov.summary: A panel-block flat transformed into a bright home with a clear layout and practical kitchen.
byt-zizkov.description: A typical Žižkov apartment received a full renewal: new wet core, kitchen, finishes and lighting. The emphasis was on family daily life, daylight and materials that withstand everyday use. The result is civil, warm and easy to live in.
byt-zizkov.heroAlt: Living room of a Žižkov apartment after full renovation
gallery: Living zone with sofa and table lamp
byt-zizkov.beforeAfterCaption: Illustrative before/after — stock photography for a demonstration portfolio, not a record of a real FORMA build.
challenges: Modernise the wet core within a panel construction.
Connect kitchen and living room without losing worktop area.
Ensure proper ventilation for bathroom and kitchen.
solutions: Lightweight partitions and precise surveying of installations.
An island and linear run with a continuous worktop.
Mechanical ventilation connected to the building shafts.

byt-smichov.title: Smíchov Apartment
byt-smichov.summary: A focused renewal of wet rooms and kitchen with an emphasis on material and daylight.
byt-smichov.description: The owners wanted to keep the overall layout, but markedly raise the quality of the kitchen and bathrooms. We designed new material compositions, concealed storage and soft lighting. The intervention is concentrated — yet it changes the feel of the whole flat.
byt-smichov.heroAlt: Kitchen in a Smíchov apartment with stone worktop
gallery: Detail of tapware and stone cladding
byt-smichov.beforeAfterCaption: An illustrative kitchen comparison — demonstration images for the portfolio, not proof of a completed commission.
challenges: Renew wet rooms without altering the whole apartment layout.
Gain more kitchen storage within the same footprint.
Unite two bathrooms in one material language.
solutions: Precise rerouting of services within existing cores.
Floor-to-ceiling cabinets and a deeper island.
A shared palette of stone, wood and matte metal.

byt-holesovice.title: Holešovice Apartment
byt-holesovice.summary: A contemporary city apartment with an open daytime wing and calm night zones.
byt-holesovice.description: This Holešovice flat connects an open daytime wing with separate bedrooms and a study. The renovation covered new finishes, kitchen, bathrooms and layout adjustments. The result is a balanced interior — urban yet soft, with an emphasis on light and movement.
byt-holesovice.heroAlt: Daytime wing of a Holešovice apartment with dining table
gallery: Living room with a large window
Open kitchen adjoining the dining area
challenges: Separate night-time quiet from social activity.
Improve natural light in a deeper plan.
Keep a coherent character across every room.
solutions: Clear zoning and door leaves with good acoustics.
Glazed views through and continuous light flooring.
One material axis: wood, plaster, textile, matte metal.
